name: translatebox-mobile
description: Native Android and iOS shells for the TranslateBox listener and console (Capacitor).

scripts.web: cd ../frontend && VITE_BACKEND_URL=${TB_SERVER_URL:?Set TB_SERVER_URL, e.g. https://translatebox.duckdns.org} npm run build
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
